Subject: Private hosting architecture review - pick a slot

Hi Leah —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Medisphere is prioritizing a private/VPC deployment with strict data residency and an audit trail for inference requests. Action items we agreed on:
- Schedule a technical architecture review (ops + network + compliance)
- Share SOC/controls summary and any required service boundary diagrams
- Confirm if on-prem installation or cloud VPC (you mentioned hybrid is possible)

To get the architecture call on calendar, can you pick one of the following 60–90 minute slots (all ET)?
1) Tue Jul 22, 10:00–11:30 ET
2) Wed Jul 23, 15:00–16:30 ET
3) Thu Jul 24, 09:00–10:30 ET

Proposed attendees from our side: myself (solutions lead), Connor O'Brien (solutions engineer — will lead the runbook/ops discussion), and Ben Carter (account lead). Please let me know if you need additional Redwood participants (security/product).

I attached a short checklist that outlines what we typically walk through in a private deployment prep call — redwood-privhost-prelim-checklist.pdf. If you can also share a short list of your attendees and any baseline network diagrams before the call, that will help us tailor the deep-dive.

Thanks — looking forward to locking in a time.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0179

Hi Neha —

Appreciate the recap and the checklist. The team reviewed and we want the architecture review to include our infra and security leads (Ilya Petrov and Simone O'Neil). Our preference is Wed Jul 23, 15:00–16:30 ET (slot 2).

A couple of asks so we come prepared:
- Can you include a short agenda in the invite (networking, KV cache/latency expectations, telemetry/audit logs, and fallback policies)?
- Please share an overview of encryption at rest/in-transit and any key management integrations you support (KMS/HSM).
- I'll attach a one-page SOC 2 summary we keep on hand for external partners — medisphere-soc2-summary.pdf.

Also, can you confirm whether you recommend a VPN or private peering approach for the initial POC? That will determine which network folks join.

Thanks,
Leah
Director of Platform Integrations | Medisphere Health
leah.martin@medisphere.com

Perfect — Wed Jul 23, 15:00–16:30 ET works for us. I created a calendar invite (priv-arch-review-invite.ics) and included Connor and Ben as presenters.

Proposed agenda (feel free to edit):
- 15:00–15:10: Introductions & goals (Leah / Neha)
- 15:10–15:30: Redwood private deployment overview (arch options for VPC vs on-prem)
- 15:30–15:50: Network connectivity patterns + recommended POC approach (VPN vs peering)
- 15:50–16:10: Security & KMS/HSM integrations, telemetry and audit logs
- 16:10–16:25: Runbook / ops handoff and next steps
- 16:25–16:30: Q&A / action items

Quick answers to your asks:
- Encryption: Redwood supports TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest by default. We integrate with customer KMS including AWS KMS and on-prem HSMs for key wrapping — Connor will bring specifics and sample policies.
- VPN vs peering: for short POCs we typically recommend VPN for speed of setup; for long-lived production we recommend private peering when supported. We'll run through pros/cons and checklist.

I've also dropped a link to our private deployment runbook that outlines expected artifacts from customer side: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bPrivOpsRunbook (see section "Network & KMS checklist").

Attachments: priv-arch-review-invite.ics

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

All set on our side for Wed Jul 23, 15:00 ET. Adding Marco (cloud engineering) to the invite; he will want a short note on the preferred VPN endpoints and whether you have recommendations for a managed VPN appliance.

One more thing: can you include a short slide (or doc link) on data retention and deletion workflows for inference logs? We need that for our privacy team. If you can share before the call, that'd be great.

Thanks — see you Wednesday.

Leah
